requiredEvidence.intern-card: Marketing Intern Northstar Labs Toronto, Canada

scenes.headline: Your internship hunt.
scenes.newInformation: Introduce the internship audience and the search in progress.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A large illustrated folder labelled INTERNSHIPS opens above the presenter.
scenes.transition: The folder fans out into a tangle of tabs.

scenes.vo: A blur of tabs. Where were you?
scenes.headline: A blur of tabs.
scenes.newInformation: The problem is losing the thread of the search, not a promised hiring result.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Illustrated role, company and status tabs drift apart; Solomon clears the clutter.
scenes.transition: Cut to an actual sample internship card.

scenes.vo: Marketing Intern. In Solomon's demo tracker.
scenes.headline: Marketing Intern. In Solomon's demo tracker.
scenes.newInformation: Explicitly introduce the sample Marketing Intern card in the existing Solomon demo.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A full-screen original card with a prominent DEMO / SAMPLE DATA label, not a claimed open vacancy.
scenes.transition: A short introduction follows the concrete sample.

scenes.headline: Meet Solomon.
scenes.newInformation: Identify Solomon as the product holding the internship context.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A clean mouthless presenter entrance with oversized brand type.
scenes.transition: Turn attention toward role and company.

scenes.vo: Keep the role and company together.
scenes.headline: Keep the role
scenes.newInformation: The sample role title and company belong to the same original tracker card.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Two exact source crops are connected, preserving their original text.
scenes.transition: Cut wider to establish the tracker.

scenes.vo: Then see where that application sits.
scenes.headline: Then see where
scenes.newInformation: Show the actual sample application tracker as context, not standalone factual grounding.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A wide original tracker view sets up a readable stage detail.
scenes.transition: Cut closer to the sample stage and its role.

scenes.headline: This sample is
scenes.newInformation: The internship card sits in the Interviewing column in the captured demo; no interview is promised.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Original column heading above original role crop with a single connecting line.
scenes.transition: Reset to explain what a recorded stage means.

scenes.vo: That's a recorded stage, not a guaranteed outcome.
scenes.headline: That's a recorded stage,
scenes.newInformation: Distinguish a tracker status from a real hiring outcome.
scenes.visualMetaphor: An illustrated status stamp sits above the presenter, without a progression animation or invented offer.
scenes.transition: Replace status with the viewer’s decision criteria.

scenes.vo: Read the dates. Check the requirements.
scenes.headline: Read the dates.
scenes.newInformation: Advice to verify dates and requirements, with no invented deadline or eligibility.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Two illustrated index cards, DATES and REQUIREMENTS, reveal sequentially.
scenes.transition: The requirements card meets the viewer’s experience.

scenes.vo: Match the role to your skills and availability.
scenes.headline: Match the role
scenes.newInformation: Use skills and availability to decide fit without guaranteeing eligibility.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A labelled illustration brings YOUR SKILLS and YOUR AVAILABILITY into a bracket.
scenes.transition: Focus the viewer on their own next action.

scenes.headline: Decide what you'll do next.
scenes.newInformation: The person chooses the next action; the product does not apply automatically.
scenes.visualMetaphor: An illustrated branching arrow resolves into a blank next-step line, with no invented automation.

scenes.vo: Return to your tracker when you need to reorient.
scenes.headline: Return to your tracker
scenes.newInformation: The tracker serves as the place to recover context.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The original Application Tracker title returns above the presenter, tying back to the product.
scenes.transition: Reassemble the exact sample role and stage.

scenes.vo: The role. The stage. The next step.
scenes.headline: The role.
scenes.newInformation: Summarize the sample’s recorded role and stage, with next step explicitly a conceptual prompt.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Original role and stage crops sit above a labelled NEXT STEP illustration; no synthetic UI.

scenes.headline: Less piecing things together.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The three illustrated tabs align into a tidy stack as Solomon gathers them.
scenes.transition: Move into the direct internship payoff.

scenes.vo: More clarity for your internship hunt.
scenes.headline: More clarity
scenes.newInformation: The benefit is clarity in the search, not an offer or response guarantee.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A clean forward arrow replaces the opening visual clutter.
scenes.transition: Hold a clear action CTA instead of ending on the logo alone.

scenes.vo: Start your internship search with Solomon.
scenes.headline: Start your internship search
scenes.newInformation: Invite the viewer to start an internship search with Solomon; no unverified URL or delivery promise.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A stable full CTA and wordmark, with enough time to read; no fake interactive button.
scenes.transition: End on the requested call to action.
